description: Discover every Instagram endpoint that can serve right now, with its path, what it takes as input, what one credit buys, and whether it paginates. Free — this reads our registry and calls nothing upstream. Use it to find the endpoint for anything the other tools do not cover, then call it with call_endpoint.

limit.description: Rows to return. Defaults to every endpoint that matched; lower it, or filter by platform, only if you want a smaller response.

q.description: Substring match over the endpoint path, e.g. 'search' or 'profile'.

name: list_endpoints

data.description: The endpoint's payload: one object, or an array for list calls.

meta.description: count, limit and next_cursor on list calls; credits_charged, credits_remaining and cache (hit or miss) on billed calls; limit_clamped when fewer items were requested upstream than the balance could cover; limit_capped when a free account's request was lowered to the free tier's 5-item ceiling.

summary: Browse every Instagram endpoint, its input and its credit cost. Free, and calls nothing upstream.
title: List every Instagram endpoint
